## Props

- `id: string` - Stable id. Also the `localStorage` suffix when `persist` is on, so renaming one resets its collapsed state for existing users - exactly the tradeoff the plugin's `DevSection` documents.
- `title: ReactNode`
- `hint?: string` - The header's hover tooltip, and where a section explains itself. The explanation is deliberately not rendered inline: a paragraph under every heading is read once and then costs vertical space forever.
- `actions?: ReactNode` - Controls rendered to the right of the title and *outside* the toggle, because a button cannot be nested inside a button. Pass real primitives (`Button`, `Tabs`, `Switch`) here.
- `defaultOpen?: boolean` - Open state on first render, before any stored value. Defaults to `true`, matching the plugin: a first-time reader should see what is in here, not a stack of closed headers.
- `persist?: boolean` - Remember the open state across reloads. Defaults on - the behavior worth porting from `DevSection`. Turn it off for a list of independent, equal-weight items (a plain FAQ), where a remembered open question is noise rather than a preference.
- `children: ReactNode` - Section contents.
- `className?: string`
- `style?: CSSProperties`
